title: The race
brief:
You and your teammate both started from the same commit. You wrote field notes; they shipped app v2. Your push WILL be rejected: origin has a commit your main does not.

That rejection is git protecting both of you. Read it, integrate their work with `git pull` (fetch plus merge), then push the joined history. Force-pushing here would delete your teammate's commit from origin. Do not be that teammate.

constraints.label: The teammate's commit survives on origin

hints: Push once and READ the rejection. Git prints the next step in the hint lines.
git pull merges origin/main into your main. You touched notes.txt, they touched app.txt: the merge is clean.
The shape: edit notes.txt, add, commit, push (rejected), pull, push.
